The '''Old Galactic Market Concourse''' was a major area of the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that remained under [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] control in the aftermath of the [[Coruscant riots (3653 BBY)|Coruscant riots]] in [[3653 BBY]] and the take over by the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]].
